title: _tryTransfer abi.decode reverts on short return-data, bricks batchClaim chunk (token-gated)
description: _tryTransfer returns callSuccess && (returndata.length == 0 || abi.decode(returndata,(bool))) (L819). A token returning non-empty return-data shorter than 32 bytes makes abi.decode revert rather than yield false; invoked inside the batchClaim flush loop (L459), the revert bubbles up and reverts the whole flush chunk, making finalizePromotion unreachable (flushCursor==_stakers.length() required).
impact: Token-assumption-gated availability edge; no fund loss. Requires the owner to configure a promo with a non-standard token whose transfer returns malformed short data (owner-vetted per promotion), but it undermines the stated 'flush must never brick' guarantee.
recommendation: Treat malformed/short return-data as a failed transfer (return false): if returndata.length < 32 return false before decoding.
specConformanceCrossRef: F-02 (V3-F-02) — 'the flush must never brick' invariant undermined (story-022).
